<thought>Based on the provided fragments—benzene (c1ccccc1), an amide carbonyl (C(=O)N), and a methyl group (C)—the most straightforward way to combine them is benzene attached to the carbonyl, which is attached to the nitrogen, which in turn is attached to the methyl group. This yields the SMILES string “c1ccccc1C(=O)NC”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1C(=O)NC</final_answer>
